description: This file defines a function 'shapeStackedSeries' that processes an array of cost records to produce a dataset suitable for rendering stacked charts with the Recharts library. It categorizes costs by a specified 'stackBy' dimension, sorts categories and services, and fills in zero-values for missing data points.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries(records, stackBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw cost aggregate records into a Recharts-compatible dataset with zero-filled stacks based on specified grouping ('environment' or 'cost_category') and options for labeling and sorting.
